examples.arabic: بص الكرسي مكسور في الحتة دي
examples.english: Look, the chair is broken in this part
examples.transliteration: boss el korsi maksour fi el hitta di

examples.arabic: انا بقعد على الكرسي وبستنى صاحبي
examples.english: I sit on the chair and wait for my friend.
examples.transliteration: ana baaod ala el korsi wa bastana sahby

examples.arabic: جدي قاعد على الكرسي وبيشرب شاي
examples.english: Grandpa is sitting on the chair and drinking tea.
examples.transliteration: gedi aed ala elkorsi webyeshrab shay

examples.english: The chair in the living room is very comfortable.

examples.arabic: فيه ترابيزة فاضية هناك وفي كرسي
examples.english: There is an empty table there, and a chair.
examples.transliteration: Fee tarabeeza fadya henak w fee korsi.

examples.arabic: انا باقعد على كرسي جمب الترابيزة
examples.english: I sit on a chair next to the table.
examples.transliteration: Ana ba'od 'ala kursi gamb el tarabeeza.
